close_reason: Created tests/task_tests.rs (7 tests: get with ids+properties, get null ids, changes paginated, set create, copy fromAccountId, query filter, queryChanges); clippy clean
description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-tasks-client/tests/task_tests.rs with 7 async wiremock tests. Reuse session.json from TA. Oracle: draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06 §4 (Task JMAP fields); RFC 8620 §5.1-5.6.

**Tests:**
1. task_get_sends_ids_and_properties: mock returns GetResponse<Task> with one task (id=task1, title=Write tests, isDraft=false); assert resp.list[0].is_draft==Some(false); assert request ids==["task1"] and properties==["id","title","isDraft"].
2. task_get_all_ids_null: call with ids=None; assert request ids field is null.
3. task_changes_paginated: mock returns hasMoreChanges:true; assert has_more_changes==true; assert request has maxChanges==10.
4. task_set_create_round_trip: call create {"k1":{"@type":"Task","title":"New task","isDraft":true}}; assert resp.created["k1"].id=="task-new1".
5. task_copy_includes_from_account_id: assert request has fromAccountId=="srcacc" and accountId=="A13824" as separate fields.
6. task_query_with_filter: pass filter {"after":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}, position=0, limit=20; assert resp.ids==["task1","task2"]; assert request has filter.after and position==0 and limit==20.
7. task_query_changes_round_trip: assert resp.removed==["task-old"], added[0].id=="task-new", added[0].index==0; assert request has sinceQueryState=="qs1" and maxChanges==5.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 7 tests pass.
title: Wiremock tests: Task/get /changes /set /copy /query /queryChanges
